data.title: 冬马和纱 · 雨中的末班车
data.description: 雨落在站牌外的路面上。和纱站在候车亭里，手中握着一张折好的车票。
data.action: standing inside the shelter holding a folded ticket
data.promptProse: Inside a glass bus shelter illuminated by a solitary buzzing fluorescent tube during a cold evening rainstorm, Touma Kazusa waits with hands deep in her dark trench coat pockets, holding a creased paper ticket. Streaming rainwater sheets down the glass walls, distorting the headlights of distant passing vehicles and neon signs into abstract streaks across the wet asphalt.
data.animaCaption: Streetlight reflected from the wet pavement reveals her face and the bus shelter.
